text:
marie: Quick heads-up — starting entitlement backfill for legacy cross-account admin roles. Will run in small batches, need checks on KMS bindings and logchain before we push.
josh: Thanks. Can you share the candidate query? worried about ownerless svcaccts sneaking through.
marie: pasted below. it's the ad-hoc filter we used last week. tweak as needed.
```
SELECT principal, role, resource FROM entitlement_snapshot
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%'
AND last_active < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
AND owner IS NULL;
```
sam: +1 on owner checks. Also ensure canary batch doesn't hit prod KMS keys — crossacct grants can be sticky.
carmen: note: some infra svcaccts are intentionally ownerless (monitoring pipeline). I'll provide a whitelist by EOD.
ben: We should also capture audit-log lineage so we can prove changes. security-bot, can you run a dry-run and post the delta?
security-bot: [automated] dry-run started for 5890001234. Found 67 candidate bindings, 12 flagged as potential KMS-granted. Preview: /alerts/5890001234/dryrun
marie: OK team — plan: 1) wait for carmen whitelist, 2) run dry-run with `--include-audit`, 3) manual review of the 12 KMS cases, 4) schedule rollouts in 5m batches with rollback tag.
josh: For rollback, document the exact binding snapshot and run `rbacctl restore --snapshot=<ts>` in runbook. I'll add the snippet.
ben: Also add a step to export CloudTrail / KMS Audit entries for the window we modify. necessary for compliance.
carmen: whitelist posted: /docs/ownerless-whitelist.csv
sam: edge case: service role used by legacy CI that issues ephemeral grants. Recommend adding a temporal exemption rather than ownerless-ok.
marie: Agreed. We'll mark those with `exemption:ci-ephemeral` and track in the ticket.
ben: FYI legal wants an attestation artifact after sweep. I'll own that deliverable.
security-bot: [automated] dry-run completed. delta: 67 -> 55 after whitelist. 9 KMS cases require manual rekey or unbind.
marie: sounds good. tagging @oncall for deployment window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. Any blockers?
josh: none from infra. I'll be oncall during the window.
sam: I'll validate logs immediately after each batch, looking for `AccessDenied` spikes.
carmen: will coordinate with CI owners for temporal exemptions.
marie: thanks all — filing follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-7890. keep updates in thread.
security-bot: [automated] ticket SEC-7890 created and linked to dry-run 5890001234.
